knownLimitations: AvatarCache disk backend is a port with an in-memory implementation; the filesystem backing belongs in Main (sandboxed renderer has no fs). Memory cache + TTL are active.
No DJ artwork in R1, so the dj layer still draws a primitive placeholder (tracked in DA-REQ-001); real DJ visuals belong to Task 11.
Reaction and command-bubble assets are resolved and available through the theme but not yet displayed on stage — they are driven by Auto Host (Task 10).
Effect visuals are single-sprite plays with alpha/scale; no particle system yet (Task 13 performance work).
PNG editing sources are not in the repository by owner decision; anyone needing them must use the locked ZIP from the ChatGPT Library.
No real-device FPS benchmark: the 30-dancer test asserts view lifecycle and no view leak, not measured frame time.
Real EulerStream credential smoke test still pending owner (unchanged from Tasks 07/08).
notesForChatGPT: No approved asset was modified, recoloured, cropped or substituted outside its own category; nothing was drawn by Claude.

VISUAL_CONTRACT.json is still status DRAFT while ASSET_MANIFEST.json is APPROVED_LOCKED, so the manifest was treated as authoritative wherever they disagree. Every divergence is enumerated in DA-REQ-001.
Top 2/3 crowns are bound to crown-blue/crown-pink because R1 ships no silver/bronze crown; rank-badge-01..10 carry the actual Top 10 numbering.
Theme is pure data: swapping DA-VISUAL-R2 in means shipping a new ThemeDefinition + manifest, with no change to Core Engine, CONTROL or renderer code.
Unresolved theme slots surface as console.warn plus ResolvedTheme.unresolved[], so a future revision with a renamed id degrades visibly instead of silently.

Suggested QA focus: avatar circle alignment inside the head socket on both regular and VIP bodies at 720x1280 and 1080x1920, crown/badge placement for top 3, and tier-4/tier-5 effect coverage in LOW mode.
